entities.name: Bruce Rondón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bruce Rondón is a Venezuelan professional baseball pitcher who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Detroit Tigers in 2013 and from 2015 through 2017 and for the Chicago White Sox in 2018. Rondón's fastball has exceeded 100 miles per hour (160 km/h).
